text:
Aisha: Quick sync — collecting SKU-level pricing/supply inputs from HW partners so our cost model can handle multi-region quirks. Can partners give a CSV with the fields below by Tue EOD? cc @Marty (CoreWeave) @Tom (Finance)

```
sku_id, region_code, commit_tier_months, list_price_per_hour, effective_price_per_hour, min_billing_minutes, spot_premium_pct, eviction_profile, commit_phasing_pct_by_pool, grace_window_minutes, burst_capacity_pct, billing_alignment, latency_premium_ms, notes
```

Aisha: Some clarifications we need in the CSV:
- eviction_profile: one of {stable, bursty, scheduled-maintenance}
- commit_phasing_pct_by_pool: comma-separated 3-way split (e.g., 60,30,10) for primary/reserve/burst
- billing_alignment: "end_of_hour" or "immediate"

Marty (CoreWeave): Can do. We'll provide per-region rows and include commit tiers (1/3/12). For eviction_profile we'll mark region-level behavior — some APAC zones are more "bursty". spot_premium_pct will be a rolling 30d avg. Note: several SKUs have min_billing_minutes=60.

Tom (Finance): Thanks — please include both list_price_per_hour and effective_price_per_hour (after marketplace credits or partner rebates). We need gross/net split to model our margin. Also add a column for currency (usd).

Priya: Also ask partners to include a small sample usage curve column if possible: p50_concurrency, p95_concurrency, and a short phrase about seasonality (e.g., "steady", "weekend-peaks"). Even rough numbers help the sim.

Marty (CoreWeave): We'll add p50/p95 and a seasonality tag. One extra: we'll include a boolean column 'preempt_notification_supported' (true/false) and 'eviction_grace_minutes' if supported. For marketplace listings we can provide list_price and effective_price_after_credits.

Diego: Quick question on region_code — are we standardizing on AWS region codes (us-west-2) or ISO country codes? recommend AWS region strings to avoid ambiguity. I'll map to our zone table during ingest.

Aisha: Use AWS region codes if partners can. If they only have country-level data, put country in 'notes' and we'll map. Also please include commit_phasing in absolute percentages that sum to 100.

Marty (CoreWeave): Will do. We'll upload a sample CSV and S3 link later today for review. Also asking legal about whether we can share 'effective_price_after_credits' publicly; we'll include it in the partner-only file if needed.

Tom (Finance): Timeline: once we ingest the CSVs we'll run a baseline sim and likely ask for clarifications on a few SKUs. Need partners' inputs by Tue EOD to hit our quarter modeling window.

Aisha: Thanks — I'll prepare a lightweight ingest/preview script that validates headers and shows a quick cost delta table (list vs effective). @Diego can you add a validation CI job for the CSV schema?

Diego: Yep — will add a validator that checks headers + region mapping + numeric ranges for min_billing/spot_premium. I'll post a PR with the check and a sample GH action.

Priya: :thumbsup: Appreciate the quick turnaround from partners.

Marty (CoreWeave): Tue EOD looks doable. Putting a note in the CSV for SKUs with scheduled maintenance windows (we'll include local TZ and recurring window).

Aisha: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the ingest script + example output once Diego's CI is in place.
